business_summary: Cetc Potevio Science&Technology Co.,Ltd. provides network communication solutions in China and internationally. The company offers 5G products, including lightweight core network 5GC, baseband processing unit, extended unit EU, radio frequency remote unit, integrated base station, micro distribution, digital repeater, 5G industrial gateway, 5G vehicle-mounted radio, 5G train access unit, and 5G handheld terminal; and private wireless, scheduling and switching, and converged communications products. It also provides Beidou-3 RSMC integrated operation service platform, smart water affairs integrated operation and management platform, smart water plant integrated operation platform, smart wastewater treatment plant integrated platform, smart irrigation district platform, intelligent gas SCADA dispatch platform, smart animal husbandry and veterinary platform, integrated application platform for public security checkpoints, small vehicle lane safety inspection equipment, large vehicle lane safety inspection equipment, and intelligent security inspection robots; internet of thing, communication accessories, and time and frequency products. In addition, the company offers consulting and design services, such as communication network planning and design, and digital ICT planning and design services; general contracting of telecommunications engineering construction; and 5G industrial applications and supervision. Further, it provides private network communication solutions for rail transit, highway, energy and electricity, emergency management, national defense mobilization, and public security; smart application solutions, including data center, smart water management, smart gas, digital agriculture, and Beidou applications; and specialized printed circuit board design and manufacturing. Cetc Potevio Science&Technology Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Guangzhou, China.
